invariants.description: Factual UI values and evidence resolve to workspace-scoped stored data, not model-authored numeric fields.
A model cannot commit a CRM task; explicit human confirmation is scoped, atomic and idempotent.
Credentials stay server-only and access cannot cross workspace boundaries.
Fixture tests and real-inference validation are visibly distinct; live failures never silently become mock successes.

checks.description: Dependencies install and application typechecks, lints and builds.
One Next application uses the agreed component/runtime stack with server-only configuration.
Migrations and believable seeded customers/deals/activities/tasks work against PostgreSQL.
Record relationships, deterministic totals and session-scoped data remain consistent.
Customers, deals, activities, tasks and pipeline can be inspected and filtered without an LLM.
Source links resolve and a manual task proposal can use the same approval path without the agent.
AI SDK ToolLoopAgent and DeepSeek provider execute a multi-step tool protocol; a mocked transport test exercises the actual adapter.
Live configuration validates credentials, bounds steps/output/time and does not use fixture routing.

requirements.title: Typed tools and explicit fixture mode

checks.description: Five typed read tools execute real scoped queries and emit source-backed result counts.
Fixture mode is labeled, uses the same tools/renderer and exposes unsupported/empty/error states honestly.
Focus, investigation and comparison schemas render; unknown types/code/extraneous fields are rejected.
Unseen or cross-workspace record/evidence references fail validation; factual fields hydrate from stored records.
Stable Today/Workspace/Explore shell, natural-language command, context carry-over and history work.
Global totals, evidence scope/freshness, loading, cancellation, empty and error states remain understandable.
A proposal creates no task before approval; rejection creates no task.
Approvals create exactly one task and activity in a transaction, including concurrent/retried requests.
Wrong workspace, altered/expired/rejected proposal or invalid input cannot execute an action.
Focus → why ACME → proposed follow-up → approve → task visible after reload in Explore passes end to end.
Tool/action status and recent runs reflect actual success/failure, not model claims.
Session signatures, request origin and data scope prevent cross-user/action access.
No browser API key; live access requires configured protection; request and run budgets are enforced.
Desktop/mobile and keyboard flows work without page-level overflow or unlabeled controls.
Automated accessibility checks and UI/UX review cover the main surfaces and important states.
All source items map to checks or explicit deferral; state/ledger/check-specific evidence and findings are durable and resumable.
README/env/demo/test instructions distinguish executed checks, mock coverage, real-model deferral and known limits; PR preserves MVP scope.
Fresh final review findings are recorded, repaired or explicitly dispositioned; reviewer limitations are not disguised.

requirements.title: Credentialed live-inference acceptance
requirements.reason: User explicitly permits credential mocks now and will supply real connections later.

checks.description: Real DeepSeek inference selects tools and renders all three workspaces correctly on repeated natural-language trials.
